entities.summary: Cees Jan Diepeveen is a former field hockey player from the Netherlands, who participated in three Summer Olympics: in Los Angeles (1984), in Seoul (1988) and finally in Barcelona (1992). In 1988 he was a member of the team that won the bronze medal in South Korea, after defeating Australia (2–1) in the Bronze Medal Game.
